text:
marie_cs: Crestline asked to slide the bring-up by ~90m. Can we confirm quota headroom and a safe autoscale bump? @engr_jun @sre_liam
engr_jun: what's their expected sustained qps and avg tokens? need to size instances.
customer_pm_kara: Kara from Crestline 1 1 - baseline 100 qps, peak 420 qps, avg token ~250, burst to 600 qps for short <5m spikes. They care about sub-200ms P95 for short requests.
sre_liam: spikes to 600 qps will blow past current max_instances=3. Recommend temporary max=9 and target_instances=5. I can open a short-lived quota ticket and pre-warm caches.
marie_cs: finance? @finance_rohan will we cover extra GPUs for the bump window?
finance_rohan: if it's under 6 hours we can use burst credits + a small top-up. Send an estimate with GPU count and hours. Fast approval likely.
engr_jun: mini runbook I'll execute:
```bash
# ramp script (k6)
k6 run --vus 150 --duration 10m scripts/crestline_ramp.js --env TOKENS=250
# then step to simulate bursts: 300 -> 600 over 3 steps
```
I'll push logs to /tmp/crestline-runs/1716660000 and post links.
sre_liam: preconfigure alerts: p95>250ms OR 5xx>3% => rollback to quant-std model. Also enable KV prefix cache replay during warmup (top 40 prefixes).
marie_cs: customer requested an enablement snippet for their ops: retry/backoff, per-request token cap, and idempotency keys. I'll draft and attach to the wrap call.
customer_pm_kara: please include a recommended client-side concurrency cap for their edge (we saw they had parallel clients causing bursts). Also can you surface a simple cost estimate so our finance knows renewal impact?
marie_cs: will do. Post-run deliverables: P95, error rate, token-unit cost delta, CPU/GPU utilization heatmap, and recommended config changes. Schedule: 15m warm, 30m ramp, 15m soak, 30m post-run review with Crestline.
deploy-bot: action: increase-pool-size scheduled at 1716660300 by sre_liam :gear:
engr_jun: I'll be on standby 1716660000-1716660500 for hotfixes and to kick off the k6 run.
finance_rohan: estimate incoming in 10m. Prefer to apply burst credits first and only bill incremental if exceeded.
sre_liam: making sure autoscale tombstones are cleared and the fallback route to quant-xxlight is configured.
marie_cs: checklist before start: (1) finance approval, (2) autoscale max=9 set, (3) KV cache primed, (4) k6 scripts smoke-passed, (5) alerting wired, (6) enablement snippet ready. Anything else?
customer_pm_kara: add a short list of post-run questions for our renewal lead: did latency meet SLO, were there unexpected errors, any configuration changes required to maintain 99.9%?
marie_cs: acknowledged. I'll publish the one-pager and ping renewal lead after the wrap. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
